guidance.sentence: Updated Full Year 2026 Earnings Outlook to At Least $19.50 Per Share; Adjusted Earnings of At Least $20.50 Per Share
The company now expects full year 2026 adjusted net earnings of at least $20.50 per share, incorporating experience through the third quarter 2026.
The company continues to target a long-term debt-to-capital ratio of approximately 40.0% by year-end.

summary: UnitedHealth raised its full year 2026 outlook to earnings of at least $19.50 per share and adjusted earnings of at least $20.50 per share, and continues to target a debt-to-capital ratio of approximately 40.0% by year-end.
